calibrated.definition: model answer := answer logit diff > its median over this item set

verdict.definition: 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound of gold-probe accuracy on model-wrong items (report half, layer chosen on the other half) > 0.5, and CI lower bounds of the paired accuracy differences vs TF-IDF and vs the type-prior baseline > 0.

post_hoc_structural_baseline.note: secondary check added after seeing results; a stronger text-only baseline than TF-IDF

audited.definition: gold probe must beat the strongest text-only baseline (chosen on the selection half among tfidf, type_prior, hyp_prior, tfidf_query, structural): 95% CI lower bound > 0 for the paired accuracy difference on all report items AND for the paired AUROC difference inside both calibrated model-answer strata.
